input.args: add a sticky note "Check the empty-state spacing" next to "D · Nothing to save" on ui/GitPanel.tsx, put a sticker on "A · Changes, docked in the shell", then mark that sticky note resolved

input.command: REPO="$PWD"; maude design bootstrap-check --root "$REPO"; echo "bootstrap=$?"; cat .design/_active.json | head -c 1500; ls .design .design/ui
input.description: Check design root and active canvas

input.command: REPO="$PWD"; RUN=.design/_runs/1ecaf37d-bf15-49b3-98fc-90dc4526a084; mkdir -p $RUN/annotations; maude design server-up --root "$REPO" 2>&1 | tail -3; maude design canvas-rects ui/GitPanel.tsx --root "$REPO" > $RUN/annotations/rects.json; jq -c '.artboards' $RUN/annotations/rects.json; maude design read-annotations ui/GitPanel.tsx --root "$REPO" --rects $RUN/annotations/rects.json | head -c 4000; ls .design/ui; grep -n "Nothing to save\|Changes, docked" .design/ui/GitPanel.tsx | head

REPO="$PWD"; RUN=.design/_runs/1ecaf37d-bf15-49b3-98fc-90dc4526a084/annotations
cat > $RUN/ops.json <<'EOF'
{ "ops": [
  { "op": "create", "type": "sticky", "ref": "@note", "text": "Check the empty-state spacing", "x": 3604, "y": 920, "parent": null },
  { "op": "sticker", "sticker": "project-status/group-100", "x": 1170, "y": 24 },
  { "op": "resolve", "id": "@note" }
] }
EOF
maude design annotate ui/GitPanel.tsx --root "$REPO" --rects $RUN/rects.json --ops $RUN/ops.json 2>&1 | head -30
maude design read-annotations ui/GitPanel.tsx --root "$REPO" --rects $RUN/rects.json
maude design screenshot --canvas ui/GitPanel.tsx --full --out $RUN/check-now.png 2>&1 | tail -2
